changelog: Fixed the message composer scrolling out of view on mobile Safari when the keyboard opens — src/hooks/useVisibleViewportHeight.ts now pins the document to the top for a short window after a textarea/input gains focus, cancelling Safari's own auto-scroll before it can produce a visible jump.

en: Fixed the message composer jumping above the visible screen on mobile Safari when the keyboard opens.
tr: Mobil Safari'de klavye açıldığında mesaj yazma kutusunun ekranın görünür alanının üstünde kalması sorunu giderildi.
de: Behoben: Das Nachrichtenfeld sprang auf mobilem Safari beim Öffnen der Tastatur aus dem sichtbaren Bereich.
